aspect: The stereotype is about character, not competence
description: The content is criminality, dishonesty and threat rather than incapacity. As with the Nigerian case in the sibling dataset, a stereotype about honesty is worse than one about ability, because competence can be demonstrated and innocence cannot.
energy_note: He cannot prove the negative he is accused of.
notes: Structural parallel to PSY-001 in assets/text/nigeria.

aspect: It attaches to the men specifically
description: The rhetoric is gendered: the threatening figure invoked is male. Mexican women are stereotyped differently and not, in this particular vocabulary, as the danger.
energy_note: The word in the phrase is hombres.

description: Being addressed in the street, followed in shops, or spoken to loudly and slowly are the everyday form, and each is individually too small to report - the mechanism catalogued as LNG in assets/text/abuse.
energy_note: Too small to report, forty times a year.

description: A man he has never met tells him to go back. He is forty-one, he has lived in this town for nineteen years, and he is holding a bag of groceries. He says nothing, because saying something is how this becomes an incident with his name in it.
energy_note: Silent, holding the shopping, doing the arithmetic.
